lessons.finding: The real track (reflection-vrchat-erp) has only 847 streams and $0 revenue. It is under the 1,000-stream threshold where Spotify pays nothing. This is the anti-pattern: a track with no campaign earns ~$0.
lessons.proposed_rule_change: Add a gate that flags any track under 1,000 streams as 'under_threshold' and requires a campaign plan before further distribution.

lessons.finding: The track has 12 YouTube views and $0 YouTube revenue. The YouTube lane is not generating measurable income for this track.
lessons.proposed_rule_change: Tracks with <100 YouTube views after 30 days should be flagged for thumbnail/title SEO review.

lessons.finding: Retention at 30s is 0.42 (42%). This is below the 50% benchmark for long-form content. The hook may not be strong enough.
lessons.proposed_rule_change: Add a retention gate: tracks with <50% 30s retention should be reviewed for hook strength before publication.

lessons.finding: The track is not published (human_gate_pending=true). It is stuck on the human approval gate. No visual has been rendered.
lessons.proposed_rule_change: Tracks stuck on human gate for >7 days should be escalated in the weekly digest.

lessons.finding: CTR is not measured (null). The YouTube Analytics API does not provide CTR directly; it requires the Data API. This metric is currently unmeasurable.
lessons.proposed_rule_change: Document that CTR requires YouTube Data API (not Analytics API) and add a separate fetcher when credentials are available.
